verdict.rationale: uv's docs describe an aggressive global cache that avoids re-downloading and re-building dependencies already fetched previously, and highlight disk-efficient caching for dependency deduplication, which is how installing prebuilt wheels from cache versus recompiling works in the Python packaging ecosystem uv is compatible with. Community reports corroborate large real-world speedups consistent with cache hits avoiding rebuilds. Missing for 10: explicit documentation distinguishing wheel (binary) vs sdist (source) install paths and confirmation cache stores prebuilt wheels specifically rather than just resolution metadata.
